n.description: Number of emails to fetch (for check, default 10)

body.description: Email body as Markdown (for send). Files from THIS conversation are addressed by their /_upload/… URL: ![alt](URL) embeds an image in the text, [name](URL) attaches the file.

attachment.description: Optional (for send): /_upload/… URL of a file from THIS conversation to attach (an uploaded image, or sandbox output like a PDF). Embedding in the body and attaching can be combined, also for the same image.
